title: Length conversion
description: Converts a length exactly between metres, kilometres, centimetres, inches, feet and miles, using the international definitions (1 ft = 0.3048 m, 1 mi = 1609.344 m).
when_not_to_use: Areas, volumes, speeds, nautical miles and historical or regional units.
output_description: value converted to to_unit, rounded to 6 decimals, and the unit
